```{r setup, include = F}
   parm <- `r parm_name`
   load <- `r load`
   data <- `r data`
   data <- data[parm_name]
   parm_l <- length(data)
   cols <- c('darkolivegreen3', 'coral', 'steelblue')
```

```{r, include = F}
   
   if(load){
      knitr::include_graphics('epsilon.png')
   }else{
      for(i in 1:parm_l){
         data[,i] |> plot(type = 'l', ylab = '')  
         if(i == 2){
            ylab <- parm_name
         }
      }
   }

```
